blocks.text: BEIJING, China — Three astronauts blasted off aboard a Chinese rocket on Wednesday, including a foreign crew member for the first time, travelling to the Tiangong space station as part of the Shenzhou-24 mission, according to state media. Beijing has poured billions into China’s space programme as it aims to land astronauts on the Moon
